helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: C30-NBOMe, or 30C-NBOMe, also known as N-(3,4,5-trimethoxybenzyl)-4-chloro-2,5-dimethoxyphenethylamine or as 25C-NB345OMe, is a serotonin receptor modulator of the phenethylamine, 2C, and 25-NB (NBOMe) families. Its affinity for the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor was similarly low (Ki = 515 nM, versus 0.82 nM for 25C-NBOMe).
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist

uses.text: The drug was encountered as a novel designer drug in Sweden in 2013. The chemical identification of C30-NBOMe has been studied and described.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its family, the NBOMes, can cause a racing heart, high blood pressure, agitation, overheating and seizures, and have caused deaths.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。同家族的 NBOMe 類藥物可能造成心跳過快、血壓升高、躁動、體溫過高與癲癇發作，並曾導致死亡。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。同家族的 NBOMe 类药物可能造成心跳过快、血压升高、躁动、体温过高与癫痫发作，并曾导致死亡。

fact.en: Most NBOMe drugs carry a single methoxy group on their added benzyl ring, which hugely boosts their pull on the 5-HT2A receptor. C30-NBOMe carries three, and that change weakens its binding instead.
fact.zh: 大多數 NBOMe 類藥物在額外接上的苄基環上只有一個甲氧基，這會大幅增強它們對 5-HT2A 受體的結合力。C30-NBOMe 卻有三個甲氧基，結果反而削弱了結合。
fact.zhHans: 大多数 NBOMe 类药物在额外置上的苄基环上只有一个甲氧基，这会大幅增强它们对 5-HT2A 受体的结合力。C30-NBOMe 却有三个甲氧基，结果反而削弱了结合。
